text:
sam: Heads up — SAST pipeline errored in staging and blocked deploys for ~18m. Root cause looks like the scanner service account failing to decrypt artifact metadata, so evidence attachments were omitted. Proposing: 1) scan-owner SLA (15m ack, 2h remediation plan), 2) small oncall rotation for scan owners, 3) RBAC change for scanner SA (least-privilege decrypt with short TTL), 4) correlation IDs in audit logs to speed triage.

anya: saw it too. repo infra/serving, PR #3421. scanner log shows KMS 403 on GetKeyVersion. link to logs: https://logs.internal/tx/6135abc -> stacktrace snippet looks like permission denied.

mike: can we avoid granting persistent decrypt? prefer ephemeral grant workflow (on-demand short-lived). giving permanent decrypt is risky.

ria: agree on ephemeral. fallback idea: if decrypt fails pipeline should attach a placeholder evidence file and mark owner severity=high so oncall picks it up immediately. avoids silent failures.

sec-bot: automated note: incident created INC-2026-0423-sast-flap and assigned to sec-oncall-shift-A.

anya: suggestion: add a correlation id to every scan job and include it in KMS audit entries + artifact metadata. triage time drops when you can join logs by id.

sam: example GH Actions snippet for correlation id to include in logs/artifacts:

```yaml
env:
  SCAN_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-sast-${{ github.sha }}
steps:
  - name: checkout
    uses: actions/checkout@v3
  - name: run scanner
    run: ./run_sast.sh --run-id $SCAN_RUN_ID
```

mike: and a minimal IAM binding proposal for scanner SA (GCP example):

```json
{
  "role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter",
  "members": ["serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

mike: but give it via ephemeral token with TTL=5m and require an automated approval check (rate-limited).

ria: add an `allowed_audit_token_sources` list and require OPA policy check before granting. logs should include who requested the grant + correlation id.

sam: action items: - sam: draft SLA doc + oncall rota proposal by EOD - anya: add correlation id to scanner + pipeline changes (PR by tomorrow) - mike: prototype ephemeral grant flow (POC this week) - ria: update incident playbook and add placeholder-evidence behavior

anya: quick question: changing IAM will need infra review — who owns that? @mike?

mike: I'll own infra ticket, will ping infra team and link ticket here :+1:

ria: also propose a nightly smoke test that validates scanner SA permissions and KMS access so we catch regressions early.

sam: yes — nightly synthetic scan + KMS decrypt check; if it fails page sec-oncall immediately.

mike: SGTM. once SLA doc + POC look good I'll schedule infra review and start the implementation.

sam: thanks everyone. tagging sec lead for visibility: @ria

(emoji reactions on thread: :thumbsup: from mike, :eyes: from anya)
